This software (Deepal+ Desktop) is a third-party, individually developed, unofficial car-system desktop tool intended only for cosmetic customization and personal learning use. It is not an official factory program and cannot be treated as a replacement.

0. Do not post about it on any official channel or official account for promotion. Forbidden! Forbidden! Forbidden!
1. Do not operate this software while driving; do not drive distracted. Traffic violations and accident risks are borne solely by the user.
2. Installing and using this software may affect the car's factory warranty and some system features; all consequences are borne by the user, and the developer bears no compensation or joint liability.
3. This software does not control the vehicle's underlying safety-critical driving systems. Issues such as black screens, restarts, or lockups caused by the user's own rooting, flashing, or third-party modules are unrelated to the developer.
4. Official QQ group: 1077179301 — join this group for feature updates, questions, feedback, suggestions and discussion.

If you have read and understood all the statements above and still wish to use this software, please wait for the countdown to finish, then type below: ok

Before using the rear fog light strobe feature, please read the following carefully:

1. Legal risk: Using strobing lights on public roads may violate road traffic safety laws and local regulations; fines, penalty points, or other legal consequences are borne solely by the user.
2. Driving safety: Strobing lights may seriously affect the vision of other drivers and pedestrians and risk causing accidents. Do not use while driving or when other road users are present.
3. Vehicle wear: Frequently switching the fog lights may accelerate wear or damage to bulbs, relays and related wiring; any resulting repair costs are borne by the user.
4. Applicable scenarios: This feature is recommended only for emergency warning use, non-public roads, or closed venues, in compliance with the law.
5. Disclaimer: The developer bears no responsibility for any personal injury, property damage, vehicle malfunction, or legal dispute resulting from use of this feature.

Tapping "I understand" means you fully understand and voluntarily accept all of the above risks.
